title: Tekken
notes: Online play for TEKKEN 8 wasn't covered in highball-db#979. Is anyone matching online on Highball? Happy to test anything (router UPnP, other modes, logs).
issues: Online matchmaking never finds an opponent. Searched for about 10 minutes with every filter on the widest setting (connection quality: any, crossplay: on, area: any). No error message, the search just keeps going. Offline modes play fine.  Checked on the Mac side:  macOS firewall off, no VPN. Windows region in the environment is Italy (LocaleName it-IT, Geo Name IT, Nation 118), so it is not the Proton-style "defaults to North America" locale issue. While searching, the game process only had a TCP connection to Steam (155.133.229.4:27024) and one listening UDP socket; I saw no connection to Bandai Namco's servers at that moment. Router UPnP: not yet confirmed. Other notes from getting it running:  On the default DXMT renderer the game stops with "DirectX 12 is not supported on your system". Switching the environment to D3DMetal fixes it. On wine-10.0 (Sikarugir) r28 + D3DMetal the game crashed after about 5 minutes (EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION reading 0x2107 in Polaris-Win64-Shipping), and because of the crash GameUserSettings.ini was never written, so graphics settings reset on every start. On Wine 11 r33 + D3DMetal: no crash, settings are saved. An "AMD graphics driver has known issues in D3D12" dialog appears at start; pressing No continues normally. On a 16 GB base M5 the game stuttered heavily on High; Medium with shadows/effects on Low and 75% resolution plays well.
